demo30x6.scenario: perf-bench --stage --scenario demo-30x6 --seed 8704, 120 s after 20 s settle; node = CCM_CORE_TRANSCRIPT=node CCM_CORE_USAGE=node, rust = defaults since WP-R2

perf-bench labels the core children role main on macOS (no --type); the sums below add them to the collector by hand
macOS collector is far below Windows (no PowerShell / git spawn cost), so the Windows gate 7.6 % is compared as the relative drop (Windows 10.3 -> 7.6 = -26 %)
demo30x6.result: rust 3.1 % vs node 4.75 % = -35 % (gate: at least the Windows -26 %) PASS
